items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Well, there was a gentleman in my home town -- who Johnny Smith often speaks of, and I don't know whether he's alive or not, his name was Tom Robbins

ctx.x: Now what was this man's name again?
Tom Robbins. And for a rundown on him, you could contact Johnnie Smith -- he was a great, he studied with him a bit. Johnnie Smith is from my home town, too.
That's interesting. Great guitarist, just wonderful.
